an5.244:1.1: pañcime bhikkhave ādīnavā manoduccarite katame pañca attāpi attānaṃ upavadati anuvicca viññū garahanti pāpako kittisaddo abbhuggacchati sammūḷho kālaṃ karoti kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā apāyaṃ duggatiṃ vinipātaṃ nirayaṃ upapajjati ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā manoduccarite. pañcime bhikkhave ānisaṃsā manosucarite
an5.244:1.7: kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokaṃ upapajjati
an5.244:1.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ānisaṃsā manosucariteti.
